cover_subtitle: Track any product, get email when it drops

slides.title: Choose the Site
slides.body: → Open the product page in a browser. → Right‑click → Inspect to find the price element’s CSS selector. Claude helps translate that into code.

slides.title: Write the Fetcher
slides.body: Claude generates a short Python script that requests the page and extracts the price using the selector. No libraries beyond requests and BeautifulSoup.

slides.title: Set the Threshold
slides.body: Add a single line: if price < 150: trigger email. Replace 150 with your own target price in RM.

slides.title: Schedule the Check
slides.body: Claude creates a cron entry (*/10 * * * *) to run the script every 10 minutes on Glitch’s free tier.

slides.title: Send the Email
slides.body: Use Python’s smtplib to send a plain‑text email to your inbox. Claude fills in the SMTP settings for a free Gmail account.

last_slide: Follow for weekly posts on building with AI from scratch.
